title: California is trying to shut down robot vs. human cage matches
hook_text: Robots are fighting humans in California.
script:
California just tried to stop a robot fighting humans.
Last month, the startup Rek hosted a cage match. It pitted a humanoid robot against human fighter Frankie LaPenna.
State athletic officials sent a cease-and-desist letter over the unsanctioned bout. They demand the company stop hosting fights involving any human without permission.
Would you step into a cage with a machine?
